body.objective: Freeze Paper 14 at exactly the Schwarzschild finite-flux and endpoint-selection scope supported by the completed symbolic-frequency radiation-class audit, whether that audit establishes survival, exclusion or a typed nondefinition.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal black-hole-symbolic-frequency-finite-flux-radiation-class disposition and all exact hashes. Reconcile Paper 14, its claim map and the black-hole atlas with the certified metric falloff, regular-tetrad behavior, real/conjugate-frequency convention, residual-gauge quotient, Lee-Wald flux class, exceptional-frequency set and lift-invariant pairing data. Preserve the exact-sequence rather than canonical-direct-sum interpretation, distinguish horizon regularity from infinity admissibility, and state only scoped endpoint nonselection unless the completed certificate proves the stronger finite-flux theorem. Correct or retain the Einstein sublocus, signed-temperature, generator-normalization, branch-dimension and omega=0 qualifications according to their existing certificates. Run the Paper 13/14 source-map verifier, strict atlas validation, rejecting mutations for causal-no-go, generic-frequency, basis-dependent XX sign and curvature-equals-metric falloff, then render the PDF twice without warnings. Land THEOREM_FROZEN only if every paper claim has nonvacuous source coverage; otherwise land DRAFT_ALLOWED with the exact remaining gate and no widened language.
body.current_gate: Paper 14 publication scope after the symbolic-frequency finite-flux classification
body.forbid: no new black-hole calculation or background; no bounded curvature called asymptotic flatness; no horizon result substituted for infinity; no leading characteristic called finite flux; no selected real-frequency fixture called a universal theorem; no canonical extra complement inferred from the Ricci-to-Bach exact sequence; no basis-dependent XX sign called invariant; no local initial-data truncation excluded by endpoint tests; no QNM, ringdown, stability, particle, ghost or unitarity promotion
activates: the black-hole companion-paper slice of the Phase 1 publication freeze
body.resource_hint: PUBLICATION FREEZE, not another radiation calculation. Consume the terminal finite-flux verdict and make Paper 14 no broader and no weaker than its exact certificate chain.
notes: A terminal obstruction or nondefinition is a valid input: it must narrow Paper 14 rather than leave the older endpoint language in place.
The asymptotic finite-flux theorem is a companion Phase 1 result and does not delay the central counterflow viability classification if this publication freeze remains DRAFT_ALLOWED.
